title: Environment
description: The research:environment block in research/ENVIRONMENT.md — what the lab can and cannot measure. It is the file a Day-1 criterion reads: an infeasible experiment has to land here as a limitation, distinct from a scientific negative. Until this schema existed the block was read by nothing and never validated, so a limitation that never got written and a limitation nobody checked looked the same.

available.description: What the lab actually has, by namespace.

limitations.description: Capabilities the environment does not support. A limitation is not a result: it says the question cannot be measured here, which is why it is kept apart from a refuted hypothesis.

harnesses.description: Surrogates the lab does have, and what each one preserves and drops. This is the environment's half of the surrogate contract: the record states the boundary for one claim, the harness states it once for every claim that uses it.

capability_map.description: Declared in the skeleton and never given a shape: no entry example exists anywhere, nothing writes it and nothing reads it. Left unconstrained rather than invented — a shape guessed here would be enforced as though it had been decided.
